```I believe that the immediate ban of raising the dead was unjust and not thought out well enough. Given the circumstances of the attempted raising of the hags, I believe it was the nature of the bodies, not the island, that caused the desecration. Raising the undead is a part of my culture, my tradition. I will not make the council or the town bend to my will. I am but one among many. I propose that the restriction on raising the dead be removed for a test, conducted in a safe area not vital to the colony. One attempt will be made to raise one body. It will be a body of a colonist not affected by the hags, and the body of one who those close to agree to be used for this test. Should the raising of the dead go poorly again, the ban would be reinstated until such time as the influence causing the corruption is clearly handled. Should it succeed, the ban will change to a set of restrictions: That raising the dead only be performed on members of the colony having no connection to the hags. That raising the dead only be done on bodies who agreed to be raised in life or have close remaining colonists who agree to the use of the body as such. That the attempt to raise the dead be done publicly with at least two council members present. And that the raising of the dead not involve the spirit or soul, only the body. Please vote at your earliest convenience. -Web.```
